edits.reason: Record native input length; allow 23- or 64-byte ID1 control buffers
Observe original device-descriptor helper return through a prologue trampoline

odd_heartbeat: last device-descriptor request return (ff = never called)
bit0: Zeus in expected registry slot 6; bit1: second extra hub in expected registry slot 8

limitations: Windows diagnostic only; vendor input bytes 56..63 are overwritten
23/64-byte handling is a compatibility hypothesis; no hardware fix claimed
Three-hub path is validated in a synthetic transport model, not on physical USB hardware
No wheel-icon update; additional bytes in 64-byte ID1 buffers are ignored
Device-side firmware acceptance and failed-image recovery remain unproven
